examples.description: Redeem the owner-minted one-time token for your API key

description: Convert an owner-issued key-issuance token into your own API key — the headless onboarding step for an agent that holds no credential yet. Keyless: the one-time token IS the credential. Minting and revocation are dashboard-only, so an agent can never self-issue authority. Redemption is strictly SINGLE-USE and atomic: on success (201) the token is consumed and the result carries {id, name, scopes, created_at, plaintext_key} — returned EXACTLY ONCE; store it immediately. Failure modes: an expired / used / revoked / unknown token yields ONE uniform ISSUANCE_TOKEN_INVALID failure (ask the owner for a fresh token, never retry); MAX_KEYS_REACHED (409) means 3 active keys — the token was NOT consumed, retry with the SAME token after the owner revokes a key. After onboarding, use get_pricing to price metered work and get_credit_balance (with your new key) for the balance. No sandbox mirror; returns SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE under a sandbox bearer. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/authentication
description_nb: Veksle inn et eierutstedt nøkkelutstedelsestoken i din egen API-nøkkel, det hodeløse oppstartssteget. Nøkkelfritt: tokenet ER legitimasjonen; utstedelse skjer kun i dashbordet. Strengt ENGANGS: ved 201 returneres plaintext_key ÉN gang, så lagre den umiddelbart. Ugyldig token gir én uniform feil, ISSUANCE_TOKEN_INVALID; MAX_KEYS_REACHED (409) betyr 3 aktive nøkler (tokenet ble IKKE forbrukt). Etterpå: bruk get_pricing og get_credit_balance. Ingen sandkassespeil; under en sandkassenøkkel returneres SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE.

token.description: The one-time key-issuance token the account owner minted in the Apier dashboard (Agent issuance tokens) and handed to you out-of-band. Single-use: it is consumed atomically on success. Never logged by Apier.

name: redeem_issuance_token

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The freshly issued API key: id, fixed name, read:* scopes, creation time, and the one-time plaintext_key.
